subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the win-back program for {Brand}, following my earlier emails on the paid-subscription recovery and the rising cost of fresh acquisition. If recovering lapsed and churned subscribers at a renewing paid start is on your roadmap, I can send the onboarding-to-renewal recovery view and a short holdout read this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for whenever defending that window moves up the list.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN health_and_fitness: references original email and earlier stages so the cascade reads as one thread; direct close with easy out (releases prospect if timing is wrong); no MobUpps figure; zero question marks; native US English register; no sign-off; no X-not-Y; no em dash.
